title: TermAl produces Engram acceptance evaluations: spawn the evaluator, select the mode, record the verdict
outcome: Engram now refuses completion without a recorded per-criterion acceptance evaluation (policy active on the Engram project store since 2026-09-18). The agreed design gives the host everything that needs a model or a workspace: selecting the mode for a task (same-session, sub-agent, independent-session), spawning the evaluator with the task outcome, criteria, evidence index and read-only workspace, and submitting the verdict through Engram's evaluate word under the evaluator's own identity. None of that exists in TermAl yet. Slices: (1) an evaluator delegation profile: read-only workspace plus exactly one tracker write, evaluate, with a built-in evaluator brief and an attempt key per spawn; (2) a tool and a UI action that request an evaluation for a work ref and resume the requester with the verdict; (3) per-project settings for the default mode, evaluator agent and model, honouring a task's pinned mode and the store policy's allowed modes; (4) sub-agent mode with host-attested parent and execution identity; (5) source fingerprint at evaluation and completion; (6) observed build evidence through the control checkpoint. Engram-side contract: docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md, section Host integration.
